name: Full-cure
doc: Full-cure (the magic, Selphie's Slot): the root and the control task - the screen flash ramp, every 20 ticks the next target's layout at its effect point with the sound, the sparkles; each target's action result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag280_full_cure.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Control
parts.doc: The flash ramp, every 20 ticks the next target's layout at its effect point with the sound, the sparkles; each target's action result

params.label: Main
params.doc: The prim-model layout main (its models' animation)

params.label: Sequence
params.doc: The sprite sequence sequence (a flipbook of 8 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
